title: mail-server: resolve #creationId in blobId-typed properties (canonical)
description:
Design: docs/design/blobext.md. Decisions: docs/design/DECISIONS.md.
Note key: B20. Crates: jmap-mail-server. Size: M.

Per docs/design/blobext.md §9 'Existing crates' (sibling servers): today a blobId of "#c1" fails parse_wire_id, so a blob created by Blob/set, Blob/upload or Blob/convert cannot be used later in the same request (RFC 8620 §5.3; blobext-03 §8 'later method calls'; RFC 9404 §4.1). In the canonical extension server jmap-mail-server, resolve #creationId via resolve_creation_ref against cx.created_ids for every blobId-typed argument/property: Email/set (attachments, bodyStructure blobId), Email/import, Email/parse, SieveScript/set blobId. Unknown creation id keeps the existing error per method. Acceptance: tests where an earlier invocation's createdIds supplies #c1 to Email/import, Email/set and SieveScript/set and the call succeeds; an unknown #ref fails as before; AGENTS.md canonical note so B21 can mirror it.
